row.title: CLAIM-BLIND-MERGE-1: claim values main bumps no longer conflict with prose rewrites
row.body: PR 1786 conflicted three times because every deploy on main rewrote the deploy count next to lines the PR rewrote. scripts/resolve_generated.py (and the seed copy) now re-merges the three stages with claim values blanked; a clean merge is kept with main's values, a prose clash stays a conflict. Verified: tests/foundation/test_conflict_markers.py ClaimBlindMerge passes both cases.
